answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation aims to create natural language text to describe the input data ... The output is a natural language text with one or more sentences to describe the facts represented by this graph.

answer_2.quote: The quality of the generated text (as well as those of the baselines) is evaluated through a variety of automatic measures, such as BLEU, METEOR, and TER ...

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk to better assess the quality of the generated texts. We evaluate the results ... with the following three measures: Coverage, Faithfulness, Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to check each triple for coverage and faithfulness, and to compare fluency between outputs.
